This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/export/csv.ts, writeCsv includes a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) by default (`bom = true`) specifically so spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 when opened directly, with comments documenting this design choice ("Spreadsheet apps use the byte order mark to detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly.").
